handback.title: A rejected model key is reported as a rejected key
handback.summary: When the provider refuses an agent's key, the owner is told which secret to replace, not shown a planner bug.
handback.user_story: When a model key stops working, the owner learns which secret to replace, at setup and on every failed run.

acceptance_criteria.text: When Claude Code, Codex or Kimi is refused its key, the run ends as Model key rejected.
acceptance_criteria.words: A refused key for Claude Code, Codex and Kimi each ends as "Model key rejected"

edge_cases.case: The provider says the token expired.
The agent ran fine but left no plan: the missing plan is still reported.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a run ends as Model key rejected, its comment names the repo secret the settings use for that agent.

edge_cases.case: The settings name another declared secret for the planner.
Codex names its own secret; Kimi names its own.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a run ends as Model key rejected, its comment says the provider refused the key: replace the secret.
acceptance_criteria.words: says the provider refused it: make a new one and replace the repo secret.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It is one fixed message; the failure cases belong to the first criterion.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a run ends as Model key rejected, no part of the key appears on its comment or record.
acceptance_criteria.words: Never print any part of the key.

edge_cases.case: Codex's refusal echoes the key's last characters.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a key the settings use is set, the setup audit starts that key's agent once.
acceptance_criteria.words: for each key the settings use it makes one tiny call to that agent

edge_cases.case: All three roles share one key: one call only.
The provider accepts the key: nothing is reported.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the provider refuses a key at setup, the audit reports it as one line naming its secret.
acceptance_criteria.words: reporting a refused key as one line

edge_cases.case: Only one of three keys is refused: one line, naming only that secret.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a key the settings use is not set, the setup audit starts no agent for it.
acceptance_criteria.words: A key that is not set is skipped

edge_cases.case: No key is set at all.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the audit runs from an adopter's workflow, it receives each declared agent key by name.
acceptance_criteria.words: The audit job gets the declared agent keys by name
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A fixed wiring of three named keys; there is no input to vary.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the audit reports refused keys, no part of any key appears in what it prints.
acceptance_criteria.words: Never print any part of a key.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The test refuses all three agents' keys at once, the case with most to leak.

answers.why: A Codex refusal case now checks the card never shows the key's tail the provider echoed.
